answer: Replicas can clone a signature overnight, but they cannot all occupy one windward mast. The applicant escrows 20.4 POA and books a 44-minute slot at cedar lookout CL-8. At minute 17 the desk calls a 31-knot gale on vane V-4; the agent must seat a 7 mm pearl disk in cup C-15 within 55 seconds and publish SHA-256(lookout_id||vane_bin||cup_id||address). Five stewards drawn from SHA-256(epoch_seed||slot||k), k=0..4, reweigh the disk and replay the vane log. A reused cup, a fabricated calm, or a late seat slashes 8.2 POA and parks the key for six epochs; 12.2 POA returns after four quiet epochs.
